title: Operate resilient recovery capabilities: decision comparison 2
teachingQuestion: Which recovery capability meets business objective without common-mode failure?
caption: Compare meaning, decision conditions, and failures. These concise distinctions are paired with the worked examples in the teaching unit.

nodes.label: Fault Tolerance
nodes.definition: fault tolerance: business threshold in the recovery/DR process.
nodes.decision: Select/authorize fault tolerance using BIA objective, dependency, capacity, accountable owner and test evidence.
nodes.failureExample: Missing, shared, stale, or unvalidated fault tolerance leaves service/data/identity/key recovery incomplete.
nodes.detail: fault tolerance: business threshold in the recovery/DR process.
